mechanism.claim: An unusually volatile completed UTC BTC day whose final six hours contain at least 35% of daily quote volume and carry at least half of the absolute daily move in the same direction represents late-session price discovery rather than an exhausted early shock. Follow that late direction for twelve elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: common strict nonzero sign of completed daily and final-six-hour returns
mechanism.why_distinct: DLVCR measures temporal concentration of traded quote volume plus late directional transport. DVBCR measured realized-variance backloading; DRCMR used daily range and close location; HVCVR used four-hour close-to-VWAP displacement and traded reversal. No prior event set or diagnostic control is reused.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed daily realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one 00:05 UTC daily late-participation clock is absent from Gross9

features.daily_valid: 1440 exact distinct minute rows in completed UTC day, finite positive coherent OHLC, finite nonnegative quote_asset_volume, positive daily quote volume; no imputation
features.late_quote_volume_share: sum quote_asset_volume from 18:00 through 23:59 divided by full-day sum
features.realized_variation: sum squared 1m close-to-close log returns within the completed day
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank against at most 90 valid days, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.direction_confirmation: daily_return and late_return have same strict nonzero sign and abs(late_return)>=0.50*abs(daily_return)

clock.decision: exact D 00:00 UTC after prior UTC day completes
clock.reservation: fixed daily decisions; global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_implied_vol: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent late-session quote-volume concentration price-discovery mechanism

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no threshold, side, hold, clock, volume-share, or subset repair.
